headline.title: Headline numbers
headline.description: One row of totals: books and pages read, pace over the last 365 days, copies owned, shelf read share, backlog size and years-at-pace. Computed from the Notion Library (Books, Editions, Reads, Authors) with the runbook counting rules.

by_year.title: Reading by year
by_year.description: Finished reads, distinct books, pages counted, rereads, DNFs, pages per calendar day, and splits by fiction, format and canon tag, per year the read ended. 2021 covers Aug–Dec; 2026 to Oct 16.

by_month.title: Reading by month
by_month.description: Finished reads and pages counted per month, Aug 2021 to Oct 2026.

genres_by_year.title: Genres by year
genres_by_year.description: Finished reads per content genre, Fiction value and year; a read with two genres counts in each. Canon tags excluded.

genres_read.title: Genres read
genres_read.description: Finished reads, distinct books and pages per content genre and Fiction value, all time. A genre can appear under both fiction and non-fiction.

eras_by_status.title: Eras by status
eras_by_status.description: Books per era of Original year, for Read, Unread (owned, never read) and Wishlist (not owned, not read).

centuries_read.title: Centuries read
centuries_read.description: Distinct books read per century of the Original year; books with no year omitted.

top_authors.title: Most-read authors
top_authors.description: Finished reads, distinct books and pages per author, top 25.

top_translators.title: Translators read
top_translators.description: Finished reads per translator or editor on the linked edition, top 20. Only reads with a linked, translated edition appear.

reads_log.title: Finished reads log
reads_log.description: Every finished read: title, author, dates, pages counted, format, fiction, form, genres, canon tag, original year, translator, reread flag. Reads.Dates estimated is ✓ on 229 of 230, so per-read speed is left blank.

other_reads.title: DNFs and current read
other_reads.description: The two DNF reads with how far they got, and the read in progress.

copies_by.title: Owned copies by format, binding, publisher
copies_by.description: Owned copies (Owned ✓, no Disposed date) counted by Format, by Binding (paper only) and by Publisher (top 20).

shelf_status.title: Shelf by status
shelf_status.description: Owned works grouped by formats held (Paper only, Kindle only, Both) and book status, with pages and how many lack a page count.

kindle_by_quarter.title: Kindle buying by quarter
kindle_by_quarter.description: Kindle copies by Acquired date, per quarter. Acquired exists on 207 of 212 Kindle copies and on no paper copy; 52 copies share 2023-11-15.

kindle_read_by_year.title: Kindle copies read, by year bought
kindle_read_by_year.description: Kindle copies per Acquired year, split by whether the work has since been read or is being read.

backlog.title: Backlog breakdowns
backlog.description: Unread shelf and wishlist books and pages by genre (split by Fiction value), era, length band and canon tag.
